items.title: FOURTH consecutive same-completed-bar window (pre-market -> morning -> pre-close -> after-hours) holds Tier-A coverage and every persistence counter FLAT while the SAME two off-hours legs now drift MONOTONICALLY in one direction across the frozen 07-31 bar: this after-hours snapshot (asOf 2026-08-02T20:30:23.326Z) again advances the intraday window without advancing the completed-bar frontier (still 2026-07-31, 287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing), so richCount/coverageCount hold 12/10, no headless adapter re-flips, and no persistence counter increments - and unlike the prior window (a single bidirectional reversal), this window shows BOTH movers continue firming in the SAME direction they turned last window: the BTC-USD leg firms a second time (30.9 -> 31.3 -> 31.6) and the global-rotation board firms again (EWS 83.7 -> 84.3 with its FX read crossing from neutral to 'Confirms leadership', EWA 66.4 -> 67.0, EWC 66.3 -> 66.7).
items.note: Genuinely new vs the prior 'off-hours bidirectional oscillation' pattern (which observed the lone crypto leg REVERSE once from easing to firming). Three new facts distinguish this run: (1) SECOND-DERIVATIVE PERSISTENCE OF THE OFF-HOURS DRIFT: the BTC-USD daily-dated leg has now traced 31.4 -> 31.1 -> 30.9 -> 31.3 -> 31.6 across five successive same-07-31-bar snapshots, i.e. it eased, then reversed, and has now firmed TWO windows in a row while holding its unchanged 2026-08-02T00:00:00.000Z stamp and Downtrend classification (mom21 -0.66, mom63 -13.92, mom126 -3.97). An off-hours re-quote that keeps drifting the same way for two windows is STILL noise on a frozen completed bar and must never move persistence. (2) A QUALITATIVE STATE CROSSING WITHOUT A BAR ADVANCE: the carried global-rotation leader EWS crossed an FX label boundary this window (fxStrength +0.25 -> +0.66, fx 'FX neutral' -> 'Confirms leadership') and EWU pulled clear into the #2 slot at 71.7 - a same-bar re-quote of a carried owning-tool read (asOf 2026-07-31T13:30:00.000Z), not a bar advance, so even a categorical flip in a carried leg does NOT increment persistence. (3) STRUCTURE STAYS BYTE-FROZEN FOR A FOURTH WINDOW: VIX 15.99 (band 'VIX 16.0', score 0), SPY 747.03 (ma50Dist +0.38%, ma200Dist +7.12%, -1.4% from the 52w high, mom126 +8.21%, mom252 +19.05%), the sector RRG (XLY into quad I accel +0.9, XLE out quad L, XLV leader quad W), the gamma/structure levels (flip 740.09, walls 741/749, EM ±4.27, signedNetGEX +2.199B), heatmap breadth 48.64% narrow, and the volatility-sizing forecast 13.9101% throttle ×1.08 are all unchanged. Signature: across >=4 same-bar windows, off-hours re-quotes can drift the SAME direction for multiple consecutive windows and even cross qualitative (FX-label) boundaries while completed-bar-anchored coverage and every persistence counter stay pinned.
items.method: Extend the 'off-hours bidirectional oscillation' detector with an 'off-hours monotonic drift + qualitative-state-crossing' test that fires when a NEWER snapshot advances the window WITHOUT advancing the completed-bar frontier AND >=1 off-hours-dated leg (a) changes value in the SAME direction as its change in the prior same-bar window, or (b) crosses a categorical boundary (e.g. an FX-strength label) on an unchanged owning-tool asOf. Trigger on SIX tests: (1) WINDOW ADVANCES BUT BAR DOES NOT = snapshot.window changes (here pre-close -> after-hours) while dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is UNCHANGED versus the prior window (still 2026-07-31) with freshSymbolCount == symbolCount and carriedSymbolCount == 0 and missingSymbolCount == 0 (287/287, 0, 0) - a same-bar re-price, NOT an append; (2) COVERAGE HELD FLAT = richCount/coverageCount unchanged (12/10) and no tool flips STALE<->ANALYZED versus the prior window; (3) STRUCTURAL LEVELS UNCHANGED = regime + bench are byte-identical (VIX 15.99 / band 'VIX 16.0' / score 0; SPY 747.03 / +0.38% / +7.12% / +8.21% / +19.05%) and the sector RRG metrics are identical (XLY into, XLE out, XLV leader); (4) OFF-HOURS MONOTONIC DRIFT = compare each off-hours-dated leg (crypto BTC-USD on its daily stamp; carried global-rotation board) to its prior-window value and record the sign of the change - here BTC-USD firms again (+) 31.3 -> 31.6 matching the prior window's firming, and the global-rotation board firms again (+) EWS 83.7 -> 84.3; (5) QUALITATIVE-STATE CROSSING = flag when a carried leg crosses a categorical boundary on an UNCHANGED owning-tool asOf - here EWS fx 'FX neutral' (+0.25) -> 'Confirms leadership' (+0.66); (6) PERSISTENCE MUST NOT INCREMENT = because no NEW distinct completed bar date exists, an identical read keeps its prior distinct-bar count (XLY stays early-persistent across [07-30, 07-31] = 2; the structural tools stay at 1 = [07-31]). HARD RULE: count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only - repeated intraday/after-hours runs (pre-market -> morning -> pre-close -> after-hours) on the SAME 07-31 bar do NOT increment the counter, and an off-hours re-priced leg drifting in ANY direction (BTC-USD 31.3 -> 31.6 on its unchanged 08-02 stamp; global-rotation EWS 83.7 -> 84.3 crossing an FX label on its unchanged 07-31 owning-tool asOf) is NOT a completed-equity-bar advance and never moves persistence.

bars.note: The completed 07-31 daily session was appended in the pre-market window; the morning, pre-close and this after-hours window all re-price the SAME 07-31 bar without advancing the frontier (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing).
